title: Team Training
meta: Short, practical CRM training sessions so your team enters data and uses it every day. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: CRM team training that people actually use
overview: A CRM only helps when people use it, and most teams stop because it feels like extra work. We run short live sessions over video using your own CRM, with your real deals and your real stages. We teach the five or six actions your team needs daily, answer questions as they come and leave you with a one page cheat sheet. Recordings are shared with your team, so new hires can catch up without a new session.

A full training week with role guides and follow up support.
list: Role guides for sales and managers

faq: Which CRM do you train on?
Whichever one you use, as long as we can view it with you on a screen share. We prepare using your own settings and sample deals, so the training matches what your team sees every day.
Do you train in a different time zone?
We find a time that suits your team inside the delivery window and confirm it in writing. Sessions are live over video, and recordings are shared afterwards for anyone who could not attend.
Do you change my CRM settings?
Training does not change your setup. If we spot a setting that confuses people, we note it for you and you can order a fix as a separate service, such as CRM Setup or Pipeline Stages.
How do I get my team to use it daily?
We keep the daily actions to a short list, show the benefit to each role and agree one simple rule, such as no deal without a next step. Managers get tips for checking the data weekly.
